**Triage — sweep ③ lane repair.** Added `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `i18n`; `needs-user-decision` kept. ⛔ No decision content added — the card carries its own, and the ruling is the maintainer's.

**Anchor** (the lane is read from where the fix lands, ⛔ never guessed from the title): `SessionUserSchema` is declared in `packages/spec/src/api/auth.ts` — confirmed via its test at `packages/spec/src/api/auth.test.ts:4`, which imports it from there. Whichever spelling wins, the published-surface half of it lands in `packages/spec`. ⇒ `domain:spec`.

**`p2`**, not `p3`: this decision gates real queued work rather than sitting on its own. **#14762** (`pm:blocked`) names precisely this question as the one its ruling did not settle — "does the user's stored locale outrank the request's `Accept-Language` for a signed-in user's own sends?" — and **#13881** (`pm:dispatched`, `pm:blocking`) is in flight on the column itself. Three spellings coexisting on a published surface is also the shape that gets more expensive per release, not less.

⚠️ Two facts a ruling here will want, measured this round and recorded so nobody re-derives them:

- **#13881 has not landed.** `git grep 13881 -- packages/` at `origin/main` returns **0 hits**, and `normalizeRecipientLocale` in `service-messaging` is **0**. Any card describing `sys_user.locale` as present is describing that branch.
- **#14787 is coupled to this, not parallel to it.** If the column is `readonly` with system-context writes only, then "the user's stored locale" is an administered value rather than a stated preference — which changes what the right precedence *is*, not merely who may write it. ⛔ Ruling these two independently can produce a pair that does not compose.

## Maintainer ruling recorded — D: retire `SessionUserSchema.language`; `/auth/me/localization.locale` becomes the one read face, projecting the user column

Director seat, summon #11, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-03.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, replying to decision batch #18 in which this card was item 1 with the recommendation D (fallback A), presented together with #14787 (item 2) because the two compose. Verbatim reply: 「同意」 — adopts D, and B on #14787.

**Ruled: D.** `SessionUserSchema.language` (`packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts`) is retired under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove with an ADR-0087 registry entry — no producer, no consumer, gone; no replacement field is added to the session contract until a real producer exists. `GET /auth/me/localization` keeps its `locale` and becomes the single read face for "this user's language", with the precedence that follows from #14787's ruling B (the column is a user-stated preference): **`sys_user.locale` when set → the request's `Accept-Language` → the deployment default.** Options A (leave the dead field), B (add `locale` beside `language` — the shape #13881 excluded) and C (breaking rename) are not taken; 不渐进 — no dual-spelling window.

Execution: `domain:spec` lane (spec half) with the `plugin-auth` endpoint in the same PR, **after PR #14775 (#13881) has merged** — the column must exist on `main` first. **`Clause-②: yes`** (a published session type loses a member; a published endpoint's semantics change) ⇒ `claude-fable-5`, `needs:contract-review`, in-seat review before ready. Step one of the dispatch is the measurement the card names: readers of `SessionUser.language` and of `/auth/me/localization` in objectui, cloud and hotcrm — any hit is changed in the same stroke (objectui by a cross-lane card with `Blocked-by:` this one), ⛔ not bridged. Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` `minor` with a BREAKING note per the launch-window convention; endpoint pin asserting the three-step precedence; #14762 (`pm:blocked`) re-reads its `Blocked-by:` once this lands.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger: director seat post #12708, summon #11.

## Dispatch — round R3 slot refill, 2026-09-04T12:47Z

Seat `domain:spec`, session `session_01H2oQebDDxYWfWZusyd8GXk`, `os-dev` subagent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, branch `claude/issue-14788-retire-session-user-language`, tree `origin/main` `c4d1354e3` (2026-09-04T12:44Z). Executes the maintainer's ruling **D** — comment 5522880441 (director seat relay, verbatim reply 「同意」, 2026-09-03), quoted for the binding part:

> **Ruled: D.** `SessionUserSchema.language` (`packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts`) is retired under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove with an ADR-0087 registry entry — no producer, no consumer, gone; no replacement field is added to the session contract until a real producer exists. `GET /auth/me/localization` keeps its `locale` and becomes the single read face for "this user's language", with the precedence that follows from #14787's ruling B (the column is a user-stated preference): **`sys_user.locale` when set → the request's `Accept-Language` → the deployment default.** Options A (leave the dead field), B (add `locale` beside `language` — the shape #13881 excluded) and C (breaking rename) are not taken; 不渐进 — no dual-spelling window.

### ① Task

1. **Retire `SessionUserSchema.language`** (`packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts:36`): remove the key; ADR-0087 D2/D3 registration as the `spec-property-retirement` playbook prescribes for this schema's strictness (a `retiredKey()` tombstone if the schema is non-strict, otherwise the retired-keys entry alone), `entries/retired-keys` for major 18, `gen:migration-registry`, `check:generated --fix`; fix `auth.test.ts:48/68` to pin the absence. Re-verify the card's premise first: `git grep -n "language" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src packages/rest/src` must still hit only `:36` and `Accept-Language`-class uses — a producer appearing since means STOP and report.
2. **Make `GET /auth/me/localization` the one read face** — handler at `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts:871-888` (⚠️ the card's `plugin-auth/src/current-user-endpoints.ts` path is stale; the ruling's "plugin-auth endpoint" is this endpoint). `locale` resolves **`sys_user.locale` when set (BCP-47 shape-checked, reuse `normalizeRecipientLocale`'s acceptance or the column's `locale_bcp47_shape` rule — never a second parser) → the request's `Accept-Language` (reuse the reader in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:1069-1091` or the request-context resolver that already feeds `execCtx.locale`; do not write a third one) → the deployment default** (`localization.locale` setting / `II18nService.getDefaultLocale()`, whichever `execCtx.locale` already derives from). `currency` / `timezone` unchanged. Unauthenticated behaviour unchanged. Pin the three-step precedence in the endpoint's test file (three cases + the malformed-column fallback).
3. **Contract text**: the endpoint's spec-side describe / response schema (find it: `git grep -n "localization" origin/main -- packages/spec/src`) says `locale` is the user's stated preference first; `content/docs` sentences that describe `/auth/me/localization` as "the request's / tenant's regional defaults" are rewritten (list them in the PR body).
4. **Consumers measured by the seat** (claim comment above): objectui reads `locale` off this endpoint (`apps/console/src/languageSeed.ts:84`, `LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`), zero readers of `SessionUser.language` — keep the response shape, and objectui needs no card. cloud / hotcrm NOT MEASURED — state that in the PR body verbatim.
5. Changesets: `@objectstack/spec` **minor + BREAKING** note (`SessionUser.language` removed; launch-window convention) with `<!-- adr-0087: registered … -->`; `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` `minor` (endpoint precedence change, behaviour-visible). Add any package whose test/typecheck you touched.

**Acceptance:** `git grep -n "language" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts` → 0 hits (control: `git grep -n "SessionUserSchema" …` non-empty); the endpoint pin's three precedence cases green; `check:generated` clean; `check-adr-0087-registration` green.

### ② Constraints

- Worktree-first: `git fetch origin main && git worktree add --no-track /home/user/objectstack-14788 -b claude/issue-14788-retire-session-user-language origin/main && cd /home/user/objectstack-14788 && pnpm install`. Never edit the shared checkout; never `git stash`.
- **Clause ② yes**: **draft** PR, `needs:contract-review` on PR and card (read-modify-write, read back), `Fixes #14788`. The seat reviews in-seat and flips ready; ⛔ you never flip ready or arm auto-merge.
- **Serial**: `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` is also regenerated by PR #15299 (armed in the merge queue). Before you report, check whether #15299 has merged (`git fetch origin main && git log origin/main --oneline -5`); if yes, merge `main` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` and regenerate; if not, say so — the seat resyncs after it lands.
- Cross-domain surface (`plugin-hono-server` is `domain:cli`) — executed here by the maintainer's ruling; keep the endpoint change to the precedence + pin, nothing else in that package.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on your change set; run every derived command; real output lines. No model identifiers anywhere. English only on GitHub. `Implemented-by:` with your session id.

### ③ Report

Return the `os-dev` JSON report (status, PR + head SHA, changed files, commands with real output, `contract_flags`, `open_questions`, `findings`). Contract flags: any consumer of `execCtx.locale` whose meaning changes, any place where `sys_user.locale` is not readable in the endpoint's context (system-context read needed?), and any mismatch between the column's shape rule and the endpoint's acceptance.

### 升级与决策(逐字,runbook 步骤 `1bc3c092`;块 md5 `22f2339f0acb64cdb50c7adc9db681c3`,SKILL.md `## 升级与决策` at `origin/main` `c4d1354e3`)

**每个方案必须沿四条固定评估轴分析,这是决策分析的核心原则,不是可选项:**

- **实际业务需求** — 它服务的是**真实存在的业务场景**,
  还是投机性能力面?判据要求**实测**(谁在写这个键、谁在读、
  示例应用与真实部署的用法),「读起来像有用」不作数。这条轴会改变结论,不是陪衬。
- **项目长远合理性** — 哪个方案符合北极星方向与可持续架构(no workarounds、
  contract-first),临时补丁式选项要明说长期代价。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错,尤其是防 AI 写元数据 app 犯错** — 哪个方案让 AI 在结构上*更难写错*:
  契约收紧(严格 schema、publish 时响亮拒绝)优于消费端宽容(`??` 回退、静默容错)——
  宽容恰是 AI 批量犯错被掩盖的温床;声明即强制,绝不让 AI 声明一个运行时不兑现的能力。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — **创业阶段聚焦原则**(维护者 2026-08-04 指示:
  「我们是一个创业项目,应该先专注于核心能力」):能力扩张默认从紧,
  无拉动的声明面按 implementation-first 处置,已发布零消费的能力不因沉没成本获得豁免。
  **过渡也从紧 —— 创业阶段不渐进**(维护者 2026-08-27 裁,逐字:「项目在创业阶段,
  用户也很少,短期不考虑渐进。」):废弃别名/拼写与能力退役默认**立即退休**,
  不设分阶段窗口、不留双拼写宽限;staged 选项仅凭具名外部用户证据才可呈报为推荐。

推荐意见必须基于这四条轴给出理由;四轴冲突时如实呈现权衡,
交维护者拍板。
